test_title: PYST 10: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 09 Oct, 2024 - Shift 2)
subject: english
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is '**length**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The context tells us that the creature was large, about six feet long, and as round and meaty as the author's wrist.
 
• The measurement of the snake is being described, and **"length"** (लंबाई) is the correct noun to denote how long Kala Nag is.
 
• "**Length**"
